children.text: Buffy, a 16-year-old high-school student and Vampire Slayer, has befriended Angel, a mysterious older boy who has been appearing at her side and helping her with her duties as the Slayer. During one of her battles, Buffy is nearly bitten by two powerful vampires when Angel intervenes and rescues her. After Angel is injured, Buffy takes him to her home to protect him, where their romantic feelings for each other begin to become more apparent.

Angel has tried to suppress his feelings for Buffy down as he is indeed a vampire and knows the relationship won't work as she is a human and is trained and has a duty to kill any supernatural creature. Buffy who has started developing feelings for Angel doesn't understand his cryptic comments alluding to him being "older than you" and prods for more answers.
